options.description: How wide each bar itself is. Defaults to a third of the terminal, 10-40.
options.name: barWidth

options.description: The character drawn for the part still to do. Defaults to a light block.
options.name: empty

options.description: Shows the time remaining beside the percentage. Defaults to false.
options.name: eta

options.description: The character drawn for the part done. Defaults to a full block.
options.name: filled

options.description: Whether a bar that finished stays in the frame. Defaults to true.
options.name: keep

options.description: Reads the clock, in milliseconds. Defaults to `performance.now()`; a test passes its own.
options.name: now

options.description: Shows how fast the work is going, in units a second. Defaults to false.
options.name: rate

options.description: How often a plain log line is written for each bar when there is no terminal, in percent. Defaults to 10. A whole number of percent: a fraction is rounded, and below 1 is every percent.
options.name: step

options.description: What a unit of work is called, shown after the rate: `files` reads `3.2 files/s`.
options.name: unit

options.description: The estimator's time constant, in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.
options.name: window

registryDescription: Several progress bars in one live region, each with a rate and a time remaining
